name: How do I choose the right size exhaust fan for my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size exhaust fan for my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: To choose the right size exhaust fan, measure your bathroom's square footage. A general rule of thumb is to have at least 1 CFM (cubic feet per minute) of ventilation for every square foot of bathroom area, for rooms up to 100 sq ft. For bathrooms larger than 100 sq ft, specific fixture-based calculations are often used. Factors like ceiling height and the presence of a separate toilet or shower area can also influence the required CFM.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select an exhaust fan by calculating your bathroom's square footage; generally, aim for at least 1 CFM per square foot.
